name: openingos-complete-product-platform
description: OpeningOS world-class beta core: premium chess opening workspace with real accounts, sync trust, repertoire workflow, imports, game repair and deployable SaaS backend.

scripts.validate:deploy: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.validate:full: npm run validate:deploy && npm run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f server/migrations/001_init.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f server/migrations/002_saas_complete.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f server/migrations/003_fix_safe_rls.sql
scripts.audit:product: npm run validate:full && npm run typecheck:e2e
